newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates rise, forint seen steady v basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates rise, forint seen steady v basket.

text.p: 0635 GMT - Hungary's overnight interest rates rose on Tuesday as a new two-week reserve period began, dealers said.
* Overnight rates traded at around the one week reverse repo level of 20.25 percent, compared to Monday's close of 18.00 percent and were expected to stay at around that level.
* The forint was expected to open slightly weaker against the dollar, in line with movements of the dollar/mark, and to remain close to the central bank's resistance level.
* The Hungarian unit was seen opening at around 187.50/55 against the dollar, compared with Monday's close of 187.40.
